claim: performance_rating follows an approximately normal distribution (mean ~50, std ~10).
No individual numeric feature has a statistically significant linear or monotonic correlation with performance_rating after multiple-testing correction.
The categorical variable salary_band has no significant association with performance_rating.
Neither linear (OLS) nor nonlinear (random forest) models can predict performance_rating better than simply using the mean.
Predictor features are mutually independent with no multicollinearity.
The dataset contains no exploitable signal; all features are pure noise.
